enumFiletype.description: A structural design pattern in object-oriented programming allowing objects with incompatible interfaces to collaborate.
Defined rules, protocols, and tools allowing different applications to communicate and exchange data.
Captures a specific design choice and the why behind it.
SVG or other-wise digitally created content.
Agreed terms and definitions, no structure yet.
Specifies the raw materials.
Chronological record of modifications and version diffs.
Various. The visible UI building blocks that accept props and return JSX (e.g., Button.tsx, Modal.tsx).
Concessions / waivers allowing deviations.
Standard technical shorthand. Global or user preferences.
Centralized static data, such as route maps, theme hex codes, or environment variables, keeping magic strings out of component files.
(or Providers) React Context definitions and their wrapper components inject global state or dependencies down the component tree.
Organized collection of structured information or data.
Mermaid graphical layouts.
The mechanism that defines how entities interact.
A manifest that lists what an assembly is made of.
Global rules, style guides, and compliance protocols.
Functions prefixed with `use` that encapsulate reusable logic and side effects outside of the component body (e.g., useAuth.ts, useFetch.ts).
The only place adapters are instantiated and wired to use cases.
Image files.
Set of programming methods that lets independent software processes share data and coordinate actions. Receive, validate, call, return.
Structural UI wrappers.
Lint/gate results, audit findings, review sign-offs.
Extracting, transforming, and loading structured or unstructured data into a new storage repository or database engine.
Analysis of a failure, the response, and preventative actions.
Required YAML Preamble Header, sets operational state of the file.
Public-facing docs (User-facing, help), SHALL NOT expose API keys.
Tutorials, onboarding, and how-to instructional content. Technical API docs, dictionaries, or lookup tables.
Encapsulates all the raw SQL queries and data access logic.
Functions dedicated to external side effects (behavior), such as REST/GraphQL data fetching, which abstracts the network layer away from the UI.
Various. Formalized technical constraints and functional requirements for a specific component/logic.
Global state management configurations and logic. Store owns application state. Asks the client for data and updates state.
Tailwind .css style files.
Regulated,controlled and allowable .json enum/tag library.
Various. Reusable structural skeletons for code or documents.
TypeScript files (.ts or .d.ts) that define the shape of data models, API responses, and shared prop contracts to ensure type safety.
Various. Pure JavaScript functions that do not rely on React. Logic like data parsing, date formatting, or math (e.g., formatDate.ts).
Specific for self-contained dashboard elements.
Dev-only, architectural notes. Internal development files, may include libraries, hotkey commands, or images.
Not Assignable. Default state for new/unsorted files. Daily notes, cheat sheets. Other.
